title: 白手套的路口
genre: Levantine dabke folk-pop with mijwiz, oud and tabla
subject: a traffic officer in white gloves at a busy crossroads whose hand signals start to follow a stomping beat, until pedestrians, delivery riders and a bus driver fall into step and the whole crossing moves in a line
caption: Levantine dabke folk-pop with mijwiz, oud and tabla, fast stomping 4/4 line-dance rhythm with a Chinese city-crossroads setting. Mijwiz double-reed pipe playing fast ornamented lines with a droning sustain, oud strumming a driving rhythmic figure, tabla and riq on a fast dabke pattern with strong downbeats, handclaps stacked on the offbeat, upright bass doubling the oud root. Live village-wedding-band energy mix, dry and punchy with room claps and tight percussion. Male lead, strong bright tenor, call-and-response delivery with a group answering, clearly sung. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 122 BPM, D minor. upbeat, communal, stomping mood. No rap, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no electric guitar, no synth bass, no EDM drop, no slow ballad passages.
lyrics:
[Intro - mijwiz, tabla and claps]

[Verse 1]
早上八點 路口大塞車
我戴上白手套 站中間
左手一指 右手一擺
腳底下 忽然有了拍子

[Pre-Chorus]
一二 一二三
紅燈停 綠燈走
大家排成一條線

[Chorus]
踏 踏 踏 踏著走
手搭肩 過馬路
白手套 往左轉
整個路口 跟著我

[Verse 2]
送餐的小哥 腳尖點地
賣菜的阿姨 菜籃也搖
公車司機 按喇叭應和

[Chorus]
踏 踏 踏 踏著走
手搭肩 過馬路
白手套 往右轉
整個路口 一起來

[Bridge - oud and tabla alone]
隊長路過 看見這一幕
問我 這算什麼指揮
我說 隊長 車都沒有堵

[Chorus]
踏 踏 踏 踏著走
手搭肩 過馬路
白手套 往前指
明天路口 還是這樣

[Outro - mijwiz and claps]
綠燈亮了 各位請過
